title: CVS Refill Status Mix
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(refill_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the CVS refill feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `refill_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the overall mood of your CVS refill feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
